sections.heading: Attuning an Essence
sections.body: Absorbing an Essence unlocks it, but it does not help in combat until it is placed in an active loadout.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Find the Loadouts panel, place the Goblin Essence into an open slot, save the loadout, and make sure the loadout is active.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: After this step, the tutorial points you to Crafting to receive your practice gear. The Essence and tutorial gear together prepare you for Lumo Ruins.
